description: Creates a new webinar from a full export payload, which is how a webinar moves to another site or comes back after a restore. Take it when you have an export in hand: "I moved to a new site, here is the file from the old one." It needs the session and the payload from the export, either from the tool or from the Export button in the dashboard, and a name for the new campaign if you want one. It always creates a new campaign and never touches an existing one, and the new webinar starts with the state the payload carries. The payload is large, so this only belongs here when you hand it over on purpose. Side effect: it acts on your connected WordPress site; nothing else is touched. Words hosts use: import webinar, export file, move to new site, restore webinar, backup restore

payload.description: The export payload as a JSON string. At most 200000 characters.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

title.description: The title of the new campaign. Leave it out to take the one in the payload.

name: wi_import_webinar
title: Create a webinar from an export payload
